* install alongside the original app ([5901471](https://github.com/debakarr/morphe-patches/commit/5901471a6aecab99b309d9e36af678aaf419daba))

patches.name: Install alongside original
patches.description: Installs the patched app under its own package name and app name, so the original app stays installed. Push notifications and some sign-in options may not work in the separate copy. Disable it to replace the original app instead.

options.description: Appended to the original package name, e.g. com.meesho.supply.sorted. Every copy installed on a device needs a different suffix.
Name shown under the launcher icon. "Default" adds " Sorted" to the original name.

patches.name: Sort by number of ratings
patches.description: Adds Sort (off / most rated / top rated), 4★+, Hide ads and a 'Ranked' list to Amazon search pages. The ranked list covers every page loaded and can fetch more pages.
